sub_problems.fills: Each beat's pulse child on Windows runs windowless (pythonw plus detached_kwargs), even when the loop itself was started under python.exe, so a mis-started loop cannot flash a console every beat.
sub_problems.what: On nt, heartbeat's pulse spawn uses windowless_spawn.background_pythonw() instead of sys.executable, with the tool's detached kwargs; off nt it is unchanged.
sub_problems.why: cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/heartbeat.py:146 spawns pulses with [sys.executable, path]. Under a python.exe loop sys.executable is python.exe, and each pulse would get its own conhost, a window per beat, which matches the recurring pop-ups Akien reported 2026-11-16 on akienlivingroom.
